verdict.rationale: Phoenix is an observability/evaluation platform, not an agent that performs tasks using tools; its documented MCP integration runs in the opposite direction — Phoenix exposes an /mcp endpoint so external MCP clients (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code) can query Phoenix's traces/datasets, not the reverse. There is no indication Phoenix itself consumes external MCP servers' tools to extend its own capabilities, which is a different product role (MCP client) than what Phoenix is built for.
